patterns.note: A two-column layout where the main content scrolls on the left, and a dedicated 'Research & Design' sidebar remains fixed on the right.
The initial large header with the 'Groth' logo and tagline transforms into a compact, sticky navigation bar at the top of the viewport upon scrolling.
The fixed right sidebar dynamically updates its internal content (images and descriptive text) in sync with the user's scroll depth through the main project list, creating a scroll-driven narrative.
Prominent use of an oversized, bold sans-serif typeface for the main brand logo and section titles, contrasted with a more understated, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A high-contrast palette featuring a light, almost off-white background, stark black text, and a warm, earthy terracotta accent color for the sticky right sidebar.

technique_notes: The main header shrinks and transitions into a sticky, compact navigation bar at the top of the page as the user scrolls down.

A fixed-position right sidebar is maintained throughout the scroll. Its internal content, including images and text, is revealed or transitioned in a sequence that is synchronized with the scroll position of the main content area, likely leveraging a scroll-trigger library to control Lottie animations or a series of content states.
Project entries in the main content area are structured with text on the left and a corresponding image on the right, alternating their visual presentation down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~5x body text) are used for primary branding and section titles, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller, tracked-out uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with predominantly square corners on images and content blocks, contributing to a precise and architectural feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing in the hero section and between project entries, creating a sense of openness and clear content separation.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the persistent right sidebar that acts as a dynamic, scroll-driven visual companion. As the user scrolls through the main project list, the sidebar's content (images and descriptions) updates in real-time, creating an engaging, synchronized narrative experience that elevates the typical project showcase.
